running_mean_std — VIDEOSTREAM recursive op

• 資料種類:video → table

• 呼叫:import videostream; videostream.running_mean_std(video) -> 'dict'(或 opsvideostream.get("running_mean_std"))

用法

整段片段的 Welford 逐像素平均 / 母體標準差 → `{"mean", "std", "n"}(table`)。

> 以下的詳細說明為原文 —— 摘要與標題已翻譯。

Equals `video.mean(0) / video.std(0)` but needs two images of state,

not the clip — the streaming form for a recording that never ends.
